acceptance: A fast unit test (wired into required CI) scans git-tracked repository files and fails if any .js, .mjs, .cjs, .ts, .tsx, .astro, or package.json file exists outside the owner-approved .omp/ agent-harness hook allowlist.

The test passes against the current tree (including .omp/hooks/pre/primary-clone-write-guard.ts) and includes a failing-before / negative test case proving a disallowed .ts or package.json path outside .omp/ is rejected.
make pr-preflight and hosted review-gate pass on the merged head.
context: Surfaced during the 2026-11-23/24 ADR audit (finding C3): adr-site-repo-split.md D9 forbids JS/TS source and package.json in core except agent-harness hooks under .omp/ (amended 2026-11-23 for .omp/hooks/pre/primary-clone-write-guard.ts), and benchbox-site enforces the reverse no-Python rule via scripts/check-repo-boundary.mjs, but core had zero automated test or CI check enforcing D9.
description:
## Problem
`docs/internal/adr/adr-site-repo-split.md` D9 forbids `.js`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`, `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.astro`, and `package.json` in `BenchBox-dev/benchbox` (core), except agent-harness hooks under `.omp/`. While `BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site` enforces the mirror no-Python rule in CI (`npm run lint:guard` / `scripts/check-repo-boundary.mjs`), core has no test or CI guard enforcing D9, so accidental JS/TS or `package.json` files can land in core unnoticed.

## Change
Add a fast unit test under `tests/unit/` (marked `pytest.mark.unit` and `pytest.mark.fast`, so it runs in required `core` CI and `make pr-preflight`) that inspects `git ls-files` (with a filesystem fallback excluding ignored build/venv dirs when `.git` is absent) and fails on any tracked `.js`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`, `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.astro`, `package.json`, or `node_modules/` path outside `.omp/`. Include a negative test proving a disallowed `.ts` or `package.json` outside `.omp/` is rejected while `.omp/hooks/pre/primary-clone-write-guard.ts` passes.

## Decision gates
- STOP if the scan discovers any currently tracked JS/TS/Astro/`package.json` file outside `.omp/`: report the exact paths to the owner rather than silently allowlisting them.
- Keep the check pure Python, fast (<1s), offline, and independent of external binaries other than `git` (with a filesystem fallback if `.git` is absent in a tarball).

## Verification rubric
- Pass: the guard test fails on a synthetic `.ts` or `package.json` outside `.omp/`, passes on the live tree containing `.omp/hooks/pre/primary-clone-write-guard.ts`, runs in the required fast unit suite, and `make pr-preflight` exits 0.
- Fail: the guard relies on hardcoded paths that miss new subdirectories, skips `.git`-absent runs unsafely, or is not executed by required CI.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. No explanatory comments or docstrings in first-party Python (`make comment-policy-check`). Stage named paths only; commit with pinned human Git identity and no agent attribution. Heavy work only via `make pr-preflight` / `make heavy-run`; never bypass `~/.benchbox/test.lock`. Open with `make pr-open`, arm with `make pr-arm`, and monitor to merge.
